  h ∈ weakRowKernel m hm ↔ HasClassicalRowRepresentative m h
def MathResearch.Spinor.WeylRegularityOnBall.{u_1} : (E : Type u_1) →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] → [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] → Prop :=
fun E [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] =>
  ∀ (u : ℍ → E),
    LocallyIntegrableOn u Ball volume →
      distributionLaplacian (Distribution.ofFun ballOpen u volume ⊤) = 0 →
        ∃ v, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ v Ball ∧ HarmonicOnNhd v Ball ∧ u =ᵐ[volume.restrict Ball] v
def MathResearch.Spinor.distributionLaplacian.{u_1} : {F : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] → [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ F] → 𝓓'(ballOpen, F) → 𝓓'(ballOpen, F) :=
fun {F} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] T =>
  ∑ μ,
    (Distribution.lineDerivCLM (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ))
      ((Distribution.lineDerivCLM (MathResearch.Fueter.coordinateBasis μ)) T)
def MathResearch.Spinor.weylRepresentative.{u_1} : {E : Type u_1} →
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℝ E] → (ℍ → E) → ℍ → E :=
fun {E} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] u a => weylSmooth ((1 - ‖a‖) / 4) u a
def MathResearch.Spinor.weylScaledKernel : ℝ → ℍ → ℝ :=
fun r q => r⁻¹ ^ 4 * weylKernel (r⁻¹ • q)
def MathResearch.Spinor.regularRepresentation : (n : ℕ) →
  (hn : 2 ≤ n) → Sp11 →* ↥(WeakBallSpace n hn) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥(WeakBallSpace n hn) :=
fun n hn => { toFun := regularUnitary n hn, map_one' := ⋯, map_mul' := ⋯ }
def MathResearch.Spinor.regularUnitary : (n : ℕ) →
  (hn : 2 ≤ n) → Sp11 → ↥(WeakBallSpace n hn) ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] ↥(WeakBallSpace n hn) :=
fun n hn g =>
  { toFun := fun f => ⟨weightedL2Action n hn g ↑f, ⋯⟩, map_add' := ⋯, map_smul' := ⋯,
    invFun := fun f => ⟨weightedL2Action n hn g⁻¹ ↑f, ⋯⟩, left_inv := ⋯, right_inv := ⋯, norm_map' := ⋯ }
def MathResearch.Spinor.regularEvaluation : (n : ℕ) →
  (hn : 2 ≤ n) → (a : ℍ) → a ∈ Ball → ↥(WeakBallSpace n hn) →L[ℂ] ↥(BinaryForm n) :=
fun n hn a ha => testIntegralCLM n hn (weylKernelTest ((1 - ‖a‖) / 4) a ⋯ ⋯) ∘SL (weakKernel n hn).subtypeL
def MathResearch.Spinor.HasClassicalRowRepresentative : (m : ℕ) → ↥(CompatibleBallL2 m) → Prop :=
fun m h =>
  ∃ H,
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ H Ball ∧
      (∀ q ∈ Ball, ∀ (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), MathResearch.Fueter.leftOperator (fun x => rowCoefficient m d (H x)) q = 0) ∧
        ↑↑h =ᵐ[weightedBallMeasure (m + 1)] H
def MathResearch.Spinor.rowCoefficient : (m : ℕ) → (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) → ↥(CompatibleRow m) → ℍ :=
fun m d h => pack ((↑((↑h).ofLp 0)).coeff d) ((↑((↑h).ofLp 1)).coeff d)
theorem MathResearch.Spinor.rowCoefficient_spinorIsometry : ∀ (m : ℕ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) (p : ↥(BinaryForm (m + 1))),
  rowCoefficient m d ((spinorIsometry m) p) = (↑m + 1)⁻¹ • (fueterCoefficientCLM (m + 1) d) p :=
